articleTitle: Should You Use Sliders for Stretching and Flexibility?
imageHeadline: Sliders for Hamstring & Hip Flexibility: Worth It?
imageSubtext: See how they work and when to skip them
pinTitle: Should you use sliders for stretching hamstrings and hips flexibility exercises
pinDescription: Sliders reduce friction during floor-based stretches, letting you control range of motion for hamstrings, hips, and splits. Learn how sliders work for flexibility training, which stretches benefit most, and when you might not need them. Get the full breakdown on the site.
